title: The race c and e cancel-signal assertion ran only for an exited outcome, so a wrong not-started outcome after a proven start skipped the SIGKILL/SIGTERM check
resolution: After a proven start the outcome must be exited with startProven and the expected signal; not-started stays allowed only where the cancel can precede the start; fail-before recorded.

title: The cgroup runner counted every argument without a leading dash as a test file, so the value of --test-name-pattern value dropped the default crash-window file
resolution: The runner takes node:test options, then --, then files; no files runs the crash windows; tests cover both option forms with and without files.

title: The stale-epoch citation included results.jsonl lines 47 and 108, which are stale ownership generation records
resolution: The ownership generation (47, 108) and recovery epoch (49, 51, 110, 112) evidence are cited separately.
